items.text: Cleveland put Raheim Sanders (CLE) on IR Tuesday with the hip he hurt @NYJ, so he misses at least four games, and signed Audric Estime off Minnesota's practice squad. Sanders is RB79 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list, or move him to an IR spot.

With Raheim Sanders on IR and Dylan Sampson not yet back from IR, the backs behind Quinshon Judkins (CLE) are Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime, signed Tuesday. Judkins is day to day with the ankle and RB24 for me vs BAL, an RB2. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Jim Harbaugh said Tuesday it is possible Ladd McConkey (LAC) works back in this week. McConkey left Week 4 @SEA with the foot after 2 targets and was active but did not play vs DEN. WR45 for me @KC, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, and WR21 rest of season. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Harbaugh called Tre' Harris (LAC) week to week with the hamstring he hurt vs DEN, and the Chargers' bye comes after Week 6, so Week 8 is the realistic return. Harris is WR63 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Quentin Johnston (LAC) will probably be limited in practice this week with the chest injury that kept him inactive vs DEN, Harbaugh said Tuesday. He is WR44 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's injury designation.

Stephen Jones said on 105.3 The Fan that CeeDee Lamb (DAL) should be ready for Green Bay after the quad bruise he took late vs TB, where he caught 2 of 5 for 9. Lamb is WR3 for me @GB Sunday night. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Mike McCarthy said Monday that Jaylen Warren (PIT) is "our featured player right now" and that his role will not change with Rico Dowdle (toe) getting healthy. Warren had 21 touches and 188 scrimmage yards in Week 5 and is RB8 for me this week @TB. He is RB23 rest of season for me, so the sell-before-Dowdle window is gone. Hold him; a near-even snap split in Dowdle's first active game would reopen the sell.
items.why: A near-even snap split with Rico Dowdle in his first active game would reopen the sell.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson (NE) played 83 percent of the snaps vs LV after TreVeyon Henderson left with the high ankle sprain, 71 percent for the game, and Henderson is out multiple weeks. Stevenson is RB14 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

Sean Payton took Denver's play-calling back from Davis Webb starting Week 5 @LAC and said he wants more balance in the run game. J.K. Dobbins (DEN) ran 18 times for 68 and a TD in that first game. Dobbins is RB27 for me vs SEA, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.

Denzel Boston (CLE) ran a route on 91 percent of the dropbacks @PIT and drew 7 targets, a 22 percent share. That is a full-time role, and the targets back it. He is WR19 for me vs BAL this week, a WR2, and WR45 rest of season. Hold him; a route share under 75 percent would change the call.
items.why: A route share under 75 percent would change the call.

items.watch: Tuesday's and Wednesday's injury reports before Thursday @DEN
items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA) was limited on Seattle's Monday estimate with the ankle he hurt on a run in Week 5, per Bob Condotta of the Seattle Times, though he missed little time in the game. He is WR2 for me @DEN Thursday with a 37.9 percent target share through Week 3. Monitor; Tuesday's and Wednesday's injury reports.

DJ Moore (BUF) sat Monday night @LAR with the AC joint sprain in his shoulder after one limited practice, and Adam Schefter reports it is not long term. Keon Coleman caught 1 of 2 targets without him. Moore is WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report before @LV.

Rashee Rice (KC) comes off the bye with the hamstring he hurt in the first quarter @LV in Week 4, which Ian Rapoport called relatively minor. He is WR38 for me vs LAC, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, until he practices. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
Dave Canales said Monday that Jalen Coker (CAR) is on track to return from the quad that kept him out in Week 4, before the bye, per Joe Person of The Athletic. WR18 for me this week @PHI, a WR2.

TreVeyon Henderson (NE) will miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain but does not need surgery, Adam Schefter reported Tuesday. Rhamondre Stevenson played 71 percent of the snaps vs LV after Henderson went down and is RB14 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2 this week. Henderson is RB26 rest of season for me; hold him.
items.why: A move to injured reserve or a timeline past four weeks would make him a drop in shallow leagues.
Fewer than 6 targets @TB, or Roman Wilson back from the finger, would make him a drop again.
items.text: Pat Freiermuth (PIT) has 4 TDs in five games, and with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR and Roman Wilson and Ben Skowronek out, he is TE12 for me @TB, a borderline start this week. He is TE27 rest of season. Hold him through Week 6; fewer than 6 targets @TB puts him back on the drop list.

items.why: A second straight game under half the backfield snaps, or a fumble benching, would make him a sell.
items.text: Cam Skattebo (NYG) lost his fourth fumble in five games @WAS, but he still took 56 of 89 running back snaps, 63 percent, to 17 for Tyrone Tracy Jr. and 16 for Najee Harris. The usage says the job is his. RB16 for me vs NO, an RB2, and RB19 rest of season. Hold him; a snap share under half or a fumble benching would change that.

items.why: Tyler Allgeier taking early-down carries as well as the passing downs would make him a sell.
items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ARI) ran 12 times for 22 with 1 target vs DET, and Tyler Allgeier kept the passing downs. Arizona also lost its left tackle for the season. Love is still the early-down back, RB21 for me @LAR, an RB2, and RB15 rest of season. Hold him; Allgeier taking early downs too would make him a sell.

Ja'Kobi Lane (BAL), on IR with the wrist, could return in Week 6, per team reports Tuesday. The rookie was competing with Rashod Bateman for the No. 2 job in camp. WR75 rest of season for me. Stash him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

items.price: a WR3 and a bench back
items.text: Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) ran 22 times vs PHI in London, a career high, and played 87.5 percent of the early-down snaps, up from 71 percent in Week 4. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is now the handcuff, and LeQuint Allen Jr. keeps third downs. Tuten is RB18 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench back.

Kimani Vidal (LAC) led the Chargers' backs with 28 snaps vs DEN, 42 percent, and ran 8 times for 57 and a TD. His snap share has climbed five straight weeks, from 7 percent in Week 1 to 42 in Week 5. He is RB61 rest of season for me, a deep-league add. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

items.why: A second straight week third in the snaps at KC makes him a sell.
items.text: Omarion Hampton (LAC) played 30 percent of the snaps vs DEN, third of the three backs, though his 14 carries still led them. He runs behind a line with one starter left from September. Hampton is RB14 rest of season for me. Hold him; a second straight week third in the snaps at KC makes him a sell.

items.watch: Thursday night's snap split vs SEA
items.text: RJ Harvey (DEN) had 3 carries and 1 target at LAC, a week after catching 10 of 10. J.K. Dobbins took 18 of the 22 running back carries and is RB36 rest of season for me. Harvey is RB33 rest of season for me. Monitor Harvey; Thursday night's snap split vs SEA.

Kendre Miller (NO) led New Orleans with 10 carries for 30 and a TD vs MIN on 14 snaps, with Travis Etienne Jr. on IR and CJ Donaldson taking the protection snaps. Miller is RB62 rest of season for me. Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
Alvin Kamara (NO) played 12 snaps vs MIN with a back injury and ran 3 times for 12. He is RB45 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report before New Orleans goes to NYG.

Tyler Shough (NO) has played two weeks in protective layers on his non-throwing left hand, and Kellen Moore would not say Monday whether it is broken. Shough threw for 96 yards and 2 INT vs MIN. He is QB12 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Jameis Winston (NYG) threw 54 times for 326 yards and 3 TDs in the tie at WAS, after 250 yards and 3 TDs in Week 4. Malik Nabers drew 20 of those targets. Winston is QB16 for me this week vs NO, a streamer, and QB33 rest of season. Stream him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Ashton Jeanty (LV) has seen his touches drop four straight weeks, from 29 in Week 1 to 13 at NE, where he played 53 percent of the snaps and Dylan Laube got 7 running back opportunities. Klint Kubiak said Jeanty is beat up and playing for his teammates. Jeanty is RB8 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

items.why: If Caleb Williams misses another start and Loveland stays under 5 targets, he becomes a bench tight end.
items.text: Colston Loveland (CHI) caught 2 of 5 for 19 at GB with the backups throwing, a week after 9 targets. Caleb Williams is on track to practice Wednesday. Loveland is TE4 rest of season for me. Hold him; Williams' return is the reset.

Michael Wilson (ARI) has 51 targets in five games, 10.2 a game, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is now in Houston. Wilson caught 4 of 7 for 30 vs DET behind a line without its left tackle. He is WR40 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench receiver.
